args.title: Ironbark warehouse automation articles — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/warehouse and its subscriber companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/warehouse/companion):

- Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with the introduction of autonomous carts.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks (per the subscriber companion piece).
